41256159.patient_population: 75 patients in the Endoscopic versus Shunt Treatment of Hydrocephalus in Infants (ESTHI) trial
41256159.model_description: an automated AI pipeline segments brain hemispheres and CSF from artifact-affected pre- and post-operative T2 MRI in infants with hydrocephalus (metallic shunt hardware), using hemi-brain volume growth curves as a proxy for whole-brain growth after shunt/ETV surgery
41256159.study_design: retrospective secondary imaging analysis of a prospective trial (preprint)

41262494.clinical_problem: assess real-time quality of fetal Doppler signals to support accurate community-based fetal monitoring in low-resource settings
41262494.patient_population: fetal Doppler recordings from rural Guatemala (training/validation) and a hospital in Leipzig, Germany (test)
41262494.model_description: a deep neural network classifies 3.75-second fetal Doppler cardiac signal segments into quality categories (good, poor, interference, talking, silent) in real time on an Android edge-computing device, to support fetal monitoring data collection by community midwives
41262494.headline_result: micro F1 97.4%, macro F1 94.2%, 99.2% accuracy for 'Good' quality (Guatemala, 5-fold CV); F1 93.3% on 'Good' quality segments (Leipzig test set)
41262494.study_design: technical framework development with cross-site validation

41274084.clinical_problem: predict the full dynamic developmental trajectory of infant functional connectivity from incomplete longitudinal resting-state fMRI, to help identify neurodevelopmental disorders
41274084.patient_population: infants with longitudinal resting-state fMRI (two datasets)
41274084.model_description: a Triplet Longitudinal Masked Autoencoder, pre-trained on large-scale functional connectivity data with a dual triplet network and identity-conditional module, predicts temporally consistent, individualized infant functional-connectome development trajectories at any given age
41274084.study_design: retrospective methodological development across two datasets

41274092.clinical_problem: evaluate feasibility of ultra-low-dose whole-body CT with deep-learning-based reconstruction to replace skeletal-survey radiography in suspected child physical abuse
41274092.patient_population: newborn whole-body anthropomorphic phantom, scored by 46 observers (38 radiographers, 8 radiologists)
41274092.model_description: a vendor deep-learning iterative reconstruction (DLIR) algorithm is applied to ultra-low-dose whole-body CT phantom images and compared with standard-dose CT for bony-anatomy visualization and diagnostic confidence in suspected physical abuse
41274092.release_evidence: GE Revolution Apex scanner with Deep Learning Iterative Reconstruction (DLIR)
41274092.dataset_size: phantom-based study (newborn whole-body anthropomorphic phantom); 46 observers
41274092.headline_result: effective dose reduced 93.5% (0.56 mSv standard-dose vs 0.04 mSv ultra-low-dose); image quality AUC(VGA) 0.75 favoring standard dose; 41% of observers confident using ultra-low-dose protocol
41274092.study_design: phantom-based observer study comparing standard-dose vs. ultra-low-dose CT protocols

41274770.exclusion_reason: general neuroradiology review of glioneuronal tumor imaging and diagnosis; radiomics/AI mentioned only briefly in passing as an emerging innovation, not the review's focus

41274967.clinical_problem: classify standard fetal ultrasound planes for effective prenatal screening
41274967.patient_population: fetal plane ultrasound scan dataset (public benchmark)
41274967.model_description: deep features are extracted from ultrasound images with a pre-trained model, then a quantum-inspired dynamic-graph feature-selection pipeline (Dynamic Graph-Based Quantum Feature Selection) selects informative features for a lightweight MLP classifier of fetal anatomical planes (brain, thorax, abdomen, femur, maternal cervix, other)
41274967.study_design: retrospective model development on benchmark dataset

41275368.exclusion_reason: adult psychiatric patients (bipolar and schizophrenia-spectrum disorders); childhood trauma assessed retrospectively via questionnaire, not a pediatric imaging study

41281953.exclusion_reason: protocol for a systematic review of general wearable fetal monitoring devices (e.g., cardiotocography-based); not focused on radiologic imaging modalities and reports no results yet (protocol only)

41282211.clinical_problem: characterize the neural representation of grammatical sentence processing in children with varying language skill using fMRI
41282211.model_description: a support vector machine multi-voxel pattern analysis is applied to fMRI data from 7-year-old children to test whether grammatically correct vs. morphologically violated sentences can be distinguished in language-related regions of interest, and classifier accuracy is correlated with standardized language-skill measures
41282211.headline_result: classifier performed near chance in language ROIs overall; lower language skill was associated with higher whole-brain classification accuracy in bilateral semantic and phonological regions

41285677.clinical_problem: define optimal gestational windows for KANET-based fetal neurodevelopmental screening using 4D ultrasound behavioral observation, with AI potential to enhance scoring objectivity
41285677.patient_population: fetuses assessed by 4D ultrasound behavioral observation (narrative review of 42 studies)
41285677.model_description: narrative review synthesizing evidence on fetal neurobehavior (KANET scoring) via 4D ultrasound and its correlation with neural circuit maturation; discusses emerging AI applications to improve scoring objectivity by detecting movement entropy, asymmetry, and latency

41295090.clinical_problem: enable AI-based skull segmentation directly from MRI (avoiding CT radiation) for craniomaxillofacial surgical planning, particularly relevant in pediatric and trauma cases
41295090.patient_population: not stated (motivated by pediatric and trauma radiation-reduction use case)
41295090.model_description: deep learning models are trained using 186 paired CT-MRI datasets (CT-based segmentation labels transferred to MRI via multimodal registration) to perform automated skull segmentation directly from MRI, avoiding CT radiation exposure
41295090.study_design: retrospective model development and validation study

41295918.clinical_problem: predict onset and risk of fetal growth restriction using a time-dependent survival model integrating serial prenatal screening markers
41295918.patient_population: 27,543 singleton pregnancies in tertiary hospitals in Taizhou City, China (2016-2022)
41295918.model_description: a time-dependent random survival forest model combines maternal biological data, serologic markers, and ultrasound measurements (e.g., abdominal circumference, femur length) across serial prenatal visits to predict the timing and risk of fetal growth restriction
41295918.headline_result: C-index 0.864; time-dependent AUC 0.87-0.91 (peak at 28-36 weeks gestation)

41300668.clinical_problem: measure radiographic angles for pre- and post-surgical assessment of flexible flat foot correction (calcaneus stop screws) in children
41300668.patient_population: children who underwent calcaneus stop screw surgery for flexible symptomatic flat foot (124 operated feet)
41300668.model_description: commercial AI software (Bone Metrics AI, Gleamer) automatically measures foot radiographic angles (calcaneus inclination, hallux valgus, 1st-2nd and 1st-5th metatarsal angles, talus-1st metatarsal angle, medial arch angle) on pre- and post-operative X-rays, compared to manual measurements
41300668.dataset_size: 659 X-rays from 124 operated feet (422 analyzable by AI, 299 met quality criteria)
41300668.headline_result: AI measurements comparable to manual for most angles; talus-1st metatarsal angle differed significantly (AI larger by 6.14 deg pre-op, 2.80 deg post-op, P<0.001); medial arch angle smaller by 1.63/0.52 deg (P<=0.013)

41307664.model_family: deep learning segmentation (VParNet and nnU-Net, CNN-based)
41307664.clinical_problem: automated segmentation and quantification of ventricular size and the aqueduct in pediatric hydrocephalus, which has irregular and asymmetric ventricular shapes
41307664.patient_population: 139 MRI scans, ages 2.6-20.3 years, with pediatric hydrocephalus
41307664.model_description: two deep learning segmentation models (VParNet and nnU-Net, the latter extended to also segment the aqueduct) are validated for automated ventricular segmentation in pediatric hydrocephalus MRI, enabling ventriculometry
41307664.headline_result: DSC 0.87-0.95, ICC 0.81-1.0 for ventricles; aqueduct segmentation (nnU-Net) DSC 0.68, ICC 0.81
41307664.study_design: retrospective model validation study with five-fold cross-validation

41307783.clinical_problem: estimate brain functional network small-world topology parameters from resting-state fMRI in children with and without ADHD
41307783.patient_population: children with ADHD and typically developing children (ADHD-200 database)
41307783.model_description: a deep neural network estimates the rewiring-probability parameter of the Watts-Strogatz small-world network model from resting-state fMRI functional connectivity data in children (ADHD-200 database)
41307783.headline_result: mean rewiring probability p = 0.804 +/- 0.003; age (not ADHD diagnosis) was a significant predictor of p (P<0.001)
41307783.study_design: retrospective methodological study on public dataset

41308515.exclusion_reason: no imaging; questionnaire-based XGBoost model of childhood trauma and school bullying predicting self-injury in young adult college students, not a radiology study

41313724.clinical_problem: detect neonatal gastrointestinal perforation (pneumoperitoneum) on abdominal radiographs
41313724.patient_population: neonates with gastrointestinal perforation and controls (multicenter)
41313724.model_description: a DeepLabV3+ model with ResNet50 backbone is fine-tuned to perform pixel-level segmentation of pneumoperitoneum on neonatal abdominal radiographs; a pixel-based threshold derived from ROC analysis classifies gastrointestinal perforation, compared to clinicians
41313724.dataset_size: 1,187 abdominal radiographs (181 perforation, 1,006 control); 830 training, 118 validation, 239 test
41313724.headline_result: median Dice 0.81 on test set; classification AUC 0.999, sensitivity 100%, specificity 98.5%
41313724.study_design: multicenter retrospective study with train/validation/test split, compared to clinicians

41313924.model_family: CNN (UNet, Attention UNet, nnUNet, DeepLabv3+) and foundation model (Segment Anything Model variants)
41313924.body_region: fetal abdomen (liver, stomach, artery, umbilical vein)
41313924.clinical_problem: segment internal fetal abdominal organs on ultrasound for prenatal screening of fetal growth and congenital anomalies
41313924.patient_population: curated dataset of fetal abdominal ultrasound images with manual segmentations
41313924.model_description: task-specific CNN segmentation architectures (UNet, Attention UNet, nnUNet, DeepLabv3+) are compared against zero-shot and adapted/fine-tuned Segment Anything Model (SAM) variants (SAM-LoRA, MedSAM, SAM Med2D) for segmenting fetal abdominal structures on ultrasound
41313924.headline_result: adapted SAM models outperformed task-specific CNNs, reaching DSC up to 0.90 (liver) and 0.80 (artery); zero-shot SAM performed poorly, especially on small/low-contrast structures

41315675.clinical_problem: characterize fetal facial expression patterns using AI to indirectly infer fetal brain activity
41315675.patient_population: 47 singleton pregnancies at 28-37 weeks of gestation
41315675.model_description: an original AI model classifies frames of fetal facial expression video into categories (e.g., neutral, mouthing) to quantify duration, transitions, and correlation dimensions, proposed as an indirect proxy for fetal brain activity
41315675.dataset_size: 57,208 frames (95.27 minutes) from 47 singleton pregnancies, 28-37 weeks gestation
41315675.headline_result: neutral and mouthing expressions had the longest durations (median 71.0 s and 53.3 s)

41323229.clinical_problem: preoperatively differentiate focal cortical dysplasia from dysembryoplastic neuroepithelial tumor in children with epilepsy using MRI radiomics
41323229.model_description: radiomics features are extracted from T1-weighted, T2-weighted, and T2-FLAIR MRI, selected via LASSO, and used to build SVM classifiers (individual-sequence and fusion models) to differentiate FCD from DNET preoperatively, compared with radiologists
41323229.headline_result: fusion radiomics model AUC 0.894 (95% CI 0.799-0.968), accuracy 82.0%, superior to junior radiologist and comparable to senior radiologist

41335748.model_family: deep learning (cross-modal synthesis model, architecture unspecified)
41335748.clinical_problem: synthesize missing T1-weighted or T2-weighted MRI from the other sequence, useful for populations (including young children) who have difficulty completing full MRI protocols
41335748.patient_population: cohorts spanning early development (young children), young adulthood, and elderly age
41335748.model_description: a deep learning cross-modal synthesis model generates T1-weighted from T2-weighted MRI (and vice versa), incorporating age information across the lifespan, including young children prone to head motion during scanning
41335748.headline_result: MSE 0.022-0.024, PSNR 18.96-21.13 across early development/young adulthood/elderly cohorts
41335748.study_design: retrospective methodological development study spanning three age cohorts

41335957.clinical_problem: detect skeletal anomalies and growth disorders in children via bone age X-rays, addressing the rarity of anomalies with self-supervised learning
41335957.patient_population: pediatric bone age X-ray patients (curated expert-validated dataset)
41335957.model_description: self-supervised learning (SSL) pretraining with Vision Transformers extracts features from unlabeled pediatric bone age X-rays; novelty detection techniques then flag rare skeletal anomalies not captured by standard bone-age assessment models
41335957.headline_result: accuracy 98.2%, AUC 99.8% for SSL-based models, outperforming non-SSL counterparts
41335957.study_design: retrospective model development and benchmarking study

41336056.exclusion_reason: uses torsobarography (dorsal surface pressure distribution), not a radiologic imaging modality; presented explicitly as a radiation-free alternative to X-ray imaging
